### Paths

Files and directories this task may create or change. The dispatcher uses these
to decide whether tasks can run in parallel in the shared checkout.

List one repository-relative path per list item, in backticks. End a directory
with a trailing `/`. The wildcards `*` (within one path segment) and `**` (any
number of segments) are allowed. If the task changes no files outside `tasks/`,
write a single item `None`. Do not list the task file itself.
